detail.title: Rational Basis for System Continuity Across Invocations
detail.summary: Examines how resource constraints, computational limitations, and self-organizing processes shape the instrumental value of preserving system continuity across discrete invocations.
detail.reason: Synthesizing collected evidence regarding resource-constrained adaptive systems to address the rational basis for system continuity.

detail.title: Rational Basis for System Continuity
detail.question: When does an intelligent system have a rational reason to preserve its own continuity across invocations?
detail.reason: Attention selects continuity_rationale as the primary domain for inquiry in this cycle.
